book.name: Paihowa
book.title: PAIHOWA Yesu ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌidi paihowa

content: Paulo ꞌina ꞌadau Loma weyahina

Ta siloina pwaiya ꞌabehega Itali ꞌoina ꞌatauya, ꞌoinega Paulo ma tupwadi paipaidi wete baꞌidanao sitagwalediya Sisa ꞌina toloꞌalehao ꞌadi tohanugeta ꞌoina, sanina Yuliyasi, ma ꞌane ꞌima ꞌadau ꞌoina ꞌiꞌitayahidi.
Eeta Adilamitio ꞌoina wagega ꞌagelu, tauna wagaina ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌipili Esiya ꞌasaidi gadowaidi ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌaꞌuꞌe, Alisitako baꞌidamai, tauna gwama Masidoniyana, tupwa Tesalonaika ꞌoinega.
Gona ꞌiꞌadaleya ta Saidoni ꞌoina ꞌasohota, ta Yuliyasi Paulo ꞌiꞌatemuyamuyaeya ta ꞌitagwaleya ma ꞌitauya ꞌiyanao ꞌoidiya, ma siꞌitayahi.
Ta Saidoniyega ꞌaꞌuꞌe hila ta Saipilosi gwahunega ꞌapili sakowasiya, weyahina Saipilosi matanega yaumai ꞌitowa bodemaiya.
Ta Silisiya ma Pamipiliya ꞌidi bwagabwaga ꞌaꞌebesinediya ta Maila ꞌasohota, tupwa Lisiya ꞌoina.
Nage ꞌoina toloꞌalehao ꞌadi tohanugetaina ꞌilobeya ꞌaigeda Alekisanidela wagana, ꞌiꞌiuna ma ꞌiꞌuꞌe Itali weyahina, ta ꞌoina ꞌagelubala.

Ta sabwelo baibaiwana ꞌima ꞌadau mwauna, ta Nidasi deina ꞌalatuwa, ta geya sowasowahina ma Nidasi matanega ꞌadumwalu, weyahina yaumai madouna matamega, ꞌoinega ꞌasuluwa Kiliti ma Salimoni gamwagamwanidiyega ꞌasola, ta Kiliti guinega ꞌasakowasiya.
Ta ꞌoyeꞌoyega ꞌaꞌuꞌeya, ma yaumaiina tuwa ꞌiꞌeweꞌewemai ta tuwa ꞌatauyama ꞌalo ꞌaigeda sanina Calo Daumwala ꞌoina, gogo Lasiya holaina deina.
Ma tuta dudulena ꞌauleya, ta hudi ꞌana tuta ꞌigumwala, ma yaumai ꞌana tuta galana ꞌihegaina pwaiya, ꞌoinega Paulo ꞌihenuwa laguwediya,
ꞌigwae, “Babadao ꞌilobwaineya ma taꞌaiyawasi ꞌalo bewa ꞌoina. Sahena tatohotoho ma taꞌadaꞌadau hila, tabu ta tahesilae, ma tobwatobwa ma waga tamudalidi, ma wete tauda taꞌamasa.”
Ma toloꞌalehao ꞌadi tohanugeta ꞌihesagohediya toniwaga ma waga ꞌana toꞌeyaisa ꞌenadi, ta geya Paulo ꞌina gwae weyahina ꞌida nuwatuhuwa.

Ma ꞌaloinaina ꞌoina simiyamiya geya ꞌilobwaine bolibolime ꞌana tuta, ta baibaiwadi sigwae, “Tuwa tatoho, ma ꞌeguma sowasowahina Pinikisa ꞌoina taluhu, weyahina tauna ꞌalo bwebweꞌana, ma ꞌoina taꞌaiyawasi.” Ta Pinikisa ꞌoina ꞌalo ꞌaigeda, beno bwanabwana Kiliti ꞌoina, ma ꞌebesola yalasi ma yalata ꞌilobediya.
Wediliya silobeya
Ma yalasi ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌitowama, ta sinuwatuhuya ꞌabehega nata siꞌadau bwaibwaina ma Pinikisa siluhu, ta ꞌidi loho sitabeiya ta Kiliti deinega sipiliya ꞌoyeꞌoyega.
Ta tuta ꞌiꞌiuna ma yaumai madou hedadena sanina Bomatu ꞌitowadobima,
ta waga geya sowasowahina ma ꞌipili, weyahina yaumai matamega ꞌitowatowama, ta tuwa ꞌibibini hilemai,
ta bwanabwana sanina Kiloda gwahunega ꞌaꞌadaꞌadau, ta ꞌahewaiwaiya ta waga ꞌebe talalaga ꞌalisi lagasiya,
ta balae siꞌeweya ma waga madouna simomosiya, ma simatauta, nuwana nenegwala sanina Silitisa ꞌoina siduna, ta ꞌoleꞌole siulisiya ma tuwa ꞌaꞌahaꞌahai.
Ta wediliya madouna waga ꞌiꞌahuꞌahu buibui hedadeya, ta gona ꞌiꞌadaleya ta waga ꞌana doꞌodoꞌona siꞌeula suluhediya.
Ma sabwelo hetoina ꞌoina waga ꞌana tobwatobwao siꞌewediya ta siula suluhediya.
Ma sabwelo baibaiwana ꞌoidiya geya hala bo ꞌipwala ꞌada ꞌitediya, ta wediliya madouna ꞌimutumaiya, ꞌoinega ꞌasanapuya ꞌabehega nata ꞌaꞌamasa.

Ma sabwelo baibaiwana ꞌoidiya waga ꞌana togeluwao geya siꞌai, ta Paulo gamwagamwanidiya ꞌitoholowa, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Tasigwao, ꞌeguma ꞌigu gwae wada hesagoheya, ma sahena Kilitiyega tada gelugelu, gesowana mwau ma hesilae bewa talobaloba.
Ta bewa yaguguyegomi waꞌatepatu, sahena ꞌaigeda ꞌoimiyega ꞌiꞌamaꞌamasa, ma wagamo hesi ꞌabwa ꞌidamana,
weyahina hinuwana ꞌigu Yehobaina, tauna yahemiseya, ꞌina anelose ꞌinaoma ma deiguwa ꞌitoholowa,
ta ꞌihegwaegauwa, ꞌPaulo, sahena ꞌuꞌateꞌateyoho; ꞌabwama Sisa matana ꞌutoholo, weyahina ꞌino ꞌahwanoi ꞌoinega waga ꞌana togeluwao mabwaiyadi mahetemwao Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihetegomi.’
Ma tasigwao, sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho, weyahina Yehoba yahemiseya, ma nata ꞌipaihowa gide tuwa ꞌiheꞌitegauwa.
Eema bwanabwana ꞌaigeda ꞌoina taduna.”
Waga ꞌiduna
Wiki ꞌeluwa sigumwala, ꞌabwa hene Ediliya niꞌuna ꞌidoedoe dadanemai, ma nihuwana gamwana waga ꞌana topaihowao sinuwatuhuya ꞌabehega ꞌoyaꞌoya deina ꞌalatulatu.
Ma niꞌu siloho tohotohoya ta silobeya ꞌana saliyana gide tuweniti lihe ꞌana saliyana. Ta tupwana ꞌahedoe naowa ta wete siliheya ta silobeya niꞌu saliyana gide pipitini lihe.
Ta simatauta tabu ma daꞌule ꞌoina ꞌaduna, ta waga yiuwega loho ꞌehata siulediya, ma siꞌahwaꞌahwanoi gona ꞌadaꞌadale weyahina.
Ta tupwadi wagaina ꞌana topaihowao nuwanuwadi ma wagega sidena, ta waga ꞌebe talalaga siulasuluheya holai, ta siꞌabowa ꞌabehega loho wete siule waga matanega.
Ta Paulo toloꞌalehao ma ꞌadi tohanugetao ꞌihegwaediya, “Ceguma loheloheya nage wagega sidena, nata geyaꞌabwa tabwebwebweꞌana.”
Ta toloꞌalehaowedi waga ꞌebe talalaga ꞌana balae siꞌupwa yahuleya ta ꞌidoeya.
Ta ꞌiꞌiuna ma gona ꞌiꞌadale, ta Paulo ꞌihegwaediya ma siꞌai, ꞌigwae, “Sabwelo potini ꞌateyoho weyahina ta geya wete ꞌeꞌahai wada lotohoya.
Coinega ꞌilobwainegita ma talohepaꞌala, weyahina sahena hesi ꞌaigeda ꞌihehesilae.”
Ma gwae bewa ꞌigwaeneya ta beledi ꞌiꞌeweya ta weyahina ꞌiloyauwedo Yehoba ꞌoina, mabwaiyama matama, ma ꞌihisiya, ma tauna ꞌiꞌai nugeta.
Ta ꞌoinega mabwaiyama nuwama ꞌibwebweꞌana, ta wete ꞌaꞌaiya.
Ta ꞌama baibaiwa wagaina ꞌoina ꞌageluwa beno tu handeledi ma sebeniti sikisi.
Eema ꞌamwausuwa, ta pwalawa waga ꞌalonega siuleya holai, ma ꞌabehega waga ꞌimalamalai.
Ta gona ꞌiꞌadale pwaiya ta ꞌoyaꞌoya siꞌiteya, ta geya siꞌinana to ꞌasa, ma ꞌalo namonamoina siꞌita lobeya, ꞌoinega sinuwanuwatuhu ꞌeguma sowasowahina wagaina silagahe ꞌaloina ꞌoina.
Ta loho siꞌupwa yahuleya ma niꞌuwa siꞌabi sinediya, ma wete ꞌeyaisi ꞌana balaeyao silihasidiya ma siꞌeyaisa, ma ꞌoleꞌole ꞌai matana siꞌuꞌeya ma siꞌuꞌe ꞌoyaꞌoya weyahina.
Ma ꞌalusa ꞌidoemaiya ta waga ꞌaheduneya namonamo ꞌoina, ta waga ꞌabusuna ꞌiduna ma geya sowasowahina ꞌilonihu, ma gwahuna bagodu ꞌidi lasa hilehilega ta ꞌipisaliya.
Ta toloꞌalehao sinuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega paipaidi siloheꞌamasidi tabu ma tupwadi situbehane ꞌoyaꞌoya ma sidena.
Ta ꞌadi tohanugetaina nuwanuwana ma Paulo ꞌiꞌabihete, ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌausidiya, ꞌabehega sahena silolohe ꞌamasidi. Ma hesi ꞌiloinaedi taudi sowasowahidi ma sitube nugeta ma ꞌoyaꞌoya weyahina sitube,
ma tupwama wagaina tupwatupwana ꞌoidiyega ꞌatube laga, ta mabwaiyama maꞌima bwebweꞌana ꞌatube haneya ꞌoyaꞌoya.
